items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Well, Henry Starr--we got him to come down, and he played with us.

ctx.x: Well, Henry Starr--we got him to come down, and he played with us. He had never played...uh...uh...in a, you know...in a cabaret or anything at that time, you know. And that started him, and he got to be...have quite a name there. He became kinda famous up there. I don't know where I got all this stuff out of. He got a name--quite a name--after that. Henry Starr. And he worked a lot. Well, I guess that's about all, ain't it?
